definition.title: Decide what each page needs
definition.description: Each week, judge every page the site shows in search from its clicks, visits, signups and audit findings: keep it, refresh it, rewrite it, merge it into a stronger page or retire it. Merges and retirements are held back whenever paid visits, links or a safe redirect target are unknown. Each URL change gets a stable ID for website.change, which asks you before it changes the site, and pages to refresh or rewrite are listed. Edits nothing itself.

prerequisites.reason: The snapshot's PostHog visits are what rule out paid traffic before any merge or retirement; without it every cut is held.
The audit's summary (reports/organic-audit/LATEST.json, from policy v12) names the pages its cannibalization, utility-page and brand-landing checks flag.

brand_terms.title: Brand terms
brand_terms.description: Leave empty to read the name from brand/BRAND.md and the host.

protected_paths.title: Paths never merged or retired
protected_paths.description: Each also covers the pages below it. Defaults to /, /pricing, /privacy, /terms and /security.

utility_paths.title: Utility paths
utility_paths.description: Sign-in, account and app screens; one that appears in search is proposed for noindex. Defaults to the common sign-in and account paths.

ad_paths.title: Ad landing page paths
ad_paths.description: Defaults to /offer/, /lp/ and URLs with utm_.

links_file.title: Optional Search Console links export in project Files
links_file.description: A CSV with Target page and Incoming links columns. Without it, a page is never proposed for removal.

audit_run_id.title: Organic audit run
audit_run_id.description: Leave empty to use the newest audit's summary (LATEST.json). A named run needs a SUMMARY.json, which audits write from policy v12.

max_rows.title: Most decision rows kept in the file
